offering_description.value: Diversified holding company with outdoor billboard advertising, rural fiber broadband internet, and specialty surety insurance. Sells ad space to advertisers, internet service to households and businesses, and surety bonds to contractors.

primary_services.value: billboard advertising; broadband internet access; surety bonding; specialty insurance underwriting

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, contractors seeking surety bonds, business internet customers; B2C: residential broadband internet subscribers

revenue_model.value: advertising: billboard ad space rented to advertisers; subscription: monthly broadband internet service fees; interest or premiums: insurance premiums on surety bonds

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates billboard structures and fiber networks, selling ad space and internet access; financial intermediary: underwrites surety bonds, taking premiums from contractors and guaranteeing project obligations

geography_served.value: US regional: Texas, Nebraska, Louisiana and other Southern and Midwestern states

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses: billboard advertising, broadband internet, surety insurance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling billboard space and broadband service directly to customers; agents / brokers: insurance brokers and agents placing surety bonds for contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: surety insurance requires state insurance licenses, medium-level FCC and local zoning rules apply to broadband and billboards

notes: Business mix and geographic footprint may have changed; details are based on my general knowledge and may be incomplete.
